trending.title: Von der Leyen ally slams EU Commission’s AI response
trending.body: Axel Voss, a Conservative German member of the European Parliament, told POLITICO that the EU is responding too slowly to AI threats.

trending.title: EU Parliament president urges Germany to do deal in US drug pricing dispute
trending.body: A deal between Washington and Berlin is needed to avoid an “impossible” race on drugs, Roberta Metsola told POLITICO.

trending.title: Europe’s tech industry slams AI panic
trending.body: The existential fear emanating from Silicon Valley and the U.N., techies say, masks what is ultimately a cybersecurity challenge.

trending.title: AI anxiety is sweeping the globe — and cutting across party lines
trending.body: Majorities in six countries said there was at least a “moderate” risk that AI could “destroy humanity,” and a plurality wanted to pause further advancement, a new POLITICO Poll found.

trending.title: EU and Canada to unveil new partnership, but it may not be ‘associate membership,’ says ambassador
trending.body: “I’m not sure what you’re going to call it,” Jonathan Wilkinson told POLITICO, but it will be “a much deeper and closer relationship.”

regulatory.body: The U.K. prime minister is due to set out his vision for relations with the EU during a major speech on Tuesday.

regulatory.title: EU’s top AI adviser urges commissioners to use the tech to fix bloc’s economy
regulatory.body: The bloc’s new AI envoy wants Brussels to focus on using AI to lift productivity, rather than chasing U.S. and Chinese models.

regulatory.body: The tech billionaire argued that Pope Leo XIV’s call to regulate AI could slow the West while China surges ahead with the technology.

regulatory.title: The world wants to secure AI. It may have to try without the US.
regulatory.body: Proposals for global AI protections and guardrails abound this week at the U.N. General Assembly, but they can’t do much without the U.S. on board.

regulatory.title: Cybercriminal group claims to steal thousands of FBI employee records
regulatory.body: The FBI said it was probing a suspected hack, after the cybercriminal group ShinyHunters claimed to have breached its systems.

regulatory.title: Rogue AI warnings are mostly ‘marketing,’ top European AI CEO says
regulatory.body: Max Junestrand, the Swedish co-founder of Legora, which builds collaborative AI tools for lawyers, said the safety warnings are a way for frontier labs to publicize the capabilities of their models.

regulatory.title: UK seeks to broker global AI agreement at G20
regulatory.body: Andy Burnham says the U.K. is “uniquely positioned” to broker international cooperation in the wake of dire AI warnings.
